stem: BOTH the article “Alone in Nature” and the poem “Wisdom in Wishes” convey the message that —

options.label: A
options.text: the natural world needs to be protected

options.label: B
options.text: people get more interested in making money as they age

options.label: C
options.text: time spent outdoors can bring happy feelings

options.label: D
options.text: adults should enjoy the outdoors as much as children do
